budget.note: Every recipe sees 256 supervised control queries per optimizer step for 40k steps (10.24M), the spike-driven-vla budget. world_size x windows_per_gpu x grad_accum x K must equal 256.

E0-base.label: spike-driven-vla base reproduction (same machine, same seed as CTS runs)

E0d-base-T2.label: base with Cross/projection T=2 (quantifies the intra-query T cost CTS removes)

E0e-ann-upper.label: DINOv3 + BERT + ANN fusion/head upper bound (repo --preset ann) on the base budget: 40k x 256, light aug, same KD

E1-cts.label: CTS main: T_q=2 per query (half the base steps), IF-soft + control-time carry + instruction memory, K=2 windows

E1-cts-T4.label: CTS at the base T=4 per query (fallback if T_q=2 costs accuracy)

E2a-if-soft-only.label: C1 alone at T_q=2: IF-soft neuron, no carry, no memory, single-query training

E2a-if-hard-only.label: IF with hard reset, no carry, no memory, T_q=2 (separates integration from residual keeping)

E2a-plif-carry.label: carry + memory with the base PLIF-hard neuron, T_q=2 (is the integrator needed for carry?)

E2b-no-carry.label: C1 + instruction memory, no membrane carry (retention = 0)

E2b-no-head-carry.label: carry in projection+fusion only (the head restarts every query)

E2b-fixed-retention.label: retention frozen at 0.9 (learned per-channel time constants vs fixed)

E2c-memory-vision.label: memory on the instruction and the visual stream

E2d-cts-T1.label: CTS at T_q=1 (with E1-cts T_q=2 and E1-cts-T4 gives the steps/accuracy curve)

E2e-K4.label: longer windows: K=4 loss queries, 8 windows/GPU

E2f-shared-norm.label: one BN statistic for all timesteps (timestep-indexed BN is a hidden clock under carry)

E3-history-tokens.label: explicit-memory baseline at the base T=4: previous-query visual tokens appended to the head memory, base neuron, no carry

E6-cts-stride6.label: optional: CTS trained for 6-step replanning (evaluate with --num_open_loop_steps 6)

P0-pilot-finetune.label: cheap signal: CTS (T=4, same T as the loaded base) fine-tuned 5k steps from the trained base EMA; not a paper number

notes: T_q (cross_timesteps) is 2 for every CTS recipe except E1-cts-T4, E3 and the pilot, which keep the base T=4.
K=3 is not offered: 256 loss queries per step is not divisible by 3.
E2-f 'no EMA BN refresh' is an evaluation variant: evaluate.py --weights raw on the E1-cts training checkpoint.
